name: Boltz-2
summary: Biomolecular structure and interaction modelling with optional affinity prediction.

steps: Create a fresh Python environment and follow the official PyPI installation instructions for boltz or boltz[cuda] after checking hardware.
Run boltz --help before any prediction; this checks the CLI without triggering a model run.
Before first inference, explain the separate model-weight and reference-data downloads, disk use, cache location, and any external MSA service choice.
install.verify_note: Run boltz --help. A full inference test is a separate step because it may download weights and use substantial compute.

notes: The official repository recommends a fresh Python environment. CPU execution is possible but much slower than CUDA.
